name: Campaign Monitor
description: Campaign Monitor is an email marketing platform for agencies and businesses to manage Clients, subscriber lists, Campaigns, templates, journeys, transactional email, and reports.
agentUseSummary: Connect Campaign Monitor through Relay-owned web-server OAuth with only ViewReports, then bind one exact visible Client. Relay serializes complete fourteen-day token-pair rotation and exposes only the selected Client ID/name, twenty recent sent Campaign IDs/dates, and aggregate counts for one Campaign proven to belong to that bounded list; subscribers, person-level reports, content, identity, links, broader APIs, arbitrary queries, pagination, exports, and writes remain blocked.

capabilities.label: Selected Client metadata
capabilities.description: Read the exact selected Campaign Monitor Client summary.

capabilities.label: Sent Campaign metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded recent sent Campaign lifecycle summaries.

capabilities.label: Campaign aggregate summary
capabilities.description: Read privacy-minimized aggregate reporting counts for one bounded Campaign.

allowed.label: Read selected Client
allowed.description: Read only the exact bound Campaign Monitor Client ID and name.

allowed.label: List recent sent Campaigns
allowed.description: Read page one of twenty recent sent Campaign IDs and dates, newest first.

allowed.label: Read Campaign aggregate summary
allowed.description: Read aggregate delivery, open, click, bounce, unsubscribe, spam, forward, like, and mention counts for one Campaign from the bounded list.

blocked.label: Access subscribers or person-level reports
blocked.description: Subscriber identity, lists, segments, contact fields, consent, recipients, opens, clicks, locations, and drilldowns are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access Campaign content or identity
blocked.description: Campaign names, subjects, sender and reply identity, message content, URLs, links, tags, recipients, and audience detail are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access broader Campaign Monitor APIs
blocked.description: Transactional messages, journeys, templates, account administration, people, billing, and broader Client resources are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change or send Campaign Monitor data
blocked.description: Creating, importing, updating, sending, administering, or deleting Campaign Monitor resources is outside V1.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary requests
blocked.description: Arbitrary Clients, dates, tags, pages, page sizes, sort directions, paths, pagination, crawling, exports, and raw API access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Three bounded reporting reads run automatically; subscriber identity, person-level reports, content, broader APIs, raw requests, exports, and writes stay blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same three read-only tools run while exact-Client binding, ViewReports-only authority, bounded Campaign membership, fixed fields, page limits, audit, redaction, and token rotation remain enforced.

providerSetup.blocker: Campaign Monitor requires Relay to register a web-server OAuth application with the exact Railway callback, ViewReports only, and secure client credentials. Railway staging credentials plus representative agency and non-agency acceptance accounts are not configured in this code-only task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, register Relay's Campaign Monitor OAuth app with https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/campaign-monitor/callback and only ViewReports, configure Railway staging client credentials, then verify state, visible-Client selection and exact binding for agency and non-agency grants, all three privacy-minimized reads, serialized complete-pair refresh, provider-managed revocation plus Relay-local disconnect, provider rate behavior, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Campaign Monitor documents preferred web-server OAuth, comma-delimited permissions including ViewReports, prefix-matched registered redirects, state, form token exchange, 1,209,600-second access tokens, complete refresh pairs, Bearer API calls, accessible Clients, and OAuth error semantics.

GET /api/v3.3/clients.json returns visible ClientID/Name pairs, and the sent-Campaign endpoint supports page, page size, and descending SentDate ordering while returning content and recipient fields that Relay strips.

The Campaign summary endpoint returns aggregate delivery and engagement counts together with Campaign name and public URLs; Relay retains only the aggregate counts after bounded Client-membership validation.
